#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
php artisan test --without-tty "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LandingPreview extends Component
{

    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId)->load(['landingPage', 'speakers']);
        $landing = $event->landingPage;

        return view('events::livewire.landing-preview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $landing === null
                ? LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, ['template' => 'classic'])
                : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, $landing->toArray()),
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
            'publishReady' => $this->eventService->publishReadiness($event, authUser()),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Support;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Shared UI action model for event surfaces.
 *
 * Keeps capability + state + cancellation checks in one place so list/detail
 * and prepare surfaces do not drift into visible-action / denied-route UX.
 */
class EventActionAvailability
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, array{visible: bool, enabled: bool}>
     */
    public function for(User $actor, Event $event): array
    {
        $cancelled = $event->cancelled_at !== null;
        $canUpdate = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.update.team', 'events.update.global');
        $canPublish = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.publish.team', 'events.publish.global');
        $canCancel = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.cancel.team', 'events.cancel.global');
        $setupEditable = in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true);
        $canViewAutomations = $this->allows(
            $actor,
            $event,
            'automations.view.team',
            'automations.view.global',
        );

        return [
            'edit' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'publish' => [
                'visible' => $canPublish && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
                'enabled' => $canPublish && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'prepare' => [
                'visible' => false,
                'enabled' => false,
            ],
            'cancel' => [
                'visible' => $canCancel,
                'enabled' => $canCancel && ! $cancelled && ! in_array($event->state, [
                    EventState::LIVE,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
            ],
            'manageLanding' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageRegistrationForm' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAutomations' => [
                'visible' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAudienceBoost' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
            ],
            'suspend' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'reactivate' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'forceEnd' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::LIVE,
            ],
            'controlRoom' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
                'enabled' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function allows(User $actor, Event $event, string $teamCapability, string $globalCapability): bool
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows($globalCapability)) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->hasTeamPermission($event->team, $teamCapability);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\EventStateLocked;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — central service for the Event domain.
 *
 * Phase 1 surface in this story: createDraft only. Subsequent stories
 * (2-2, 2-3a, 2-3b, 2-5, 2-6) extend this service with updateMetadata,
 * transition, publish (wrapper), cancel, suspend, reactivate.
 */
class EventService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authz,
        private readonly EventReadService $reader,
        private readonly EventStateMachineService $stateMachine,
        private readonly EventModerationService $moderation,
        private readonly EventLifecycleService $lifecycle,
        private readonly EventMetadataService $metadata,
        private readonly EventLandingService $landing,
        private readonly PublicRegistrationService $publicRegistration,
        private readonly PublicLandingService $publicLanding,
    ) {}

    public function getById(int $id): Event
    {
        return $this->reader->getById($id);
    }

    /** @param array{search?: string|null, date_from?: string|null, date_to?: string|null} $filters */
    public function getPaginatedByTab(string $tab, int $perPage = 25, array $filters = []): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $this->reader->getPaginatedByTab($tab, $perPage, $filters);
    }

    /** @return Collection<int, Event> */
    public function getDashboardEventsForTeam(Team $team, int $limit = 5): Collection
    {
        return $this->reader->getDashboardEventsForTeam($team, $limit);
    }

    public function countEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    public function countUpcomingEventsForTeam(Team $team): int
    {
        return $this->reader->countUpcomingEventsForTeam($team);
    }

    /**
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeView.
     * Kept as a public method so EventController::show() and the edit flow
     * can call it without knowing the authz service directly.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeViewAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * List-access guard: actor may list events in their current team.
     *
     * Delegates to EventAuthorizationService::authorizeViewAny, which preserves
     * the current EventPolicy::viewAny behavior (events.view.global or events.view.team).
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeListAccess(User $actor): void
    {
        $team = $actor->currentTeam;

        if ($team === null) {
            throw new AuthorizationException('A team context is required to list events.');
        }

        $this->authz->authorizeViewAny($team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Combined edit-form guard: view capability + update capability + state check.
     * The state check (DRAFT + not cancelled) is NOT a capability — it stays here.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     * @throws EventStateLocked
     */
    public function authorizeEditFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);

        if ($event->state !== EventState::DRAFT || $event->cancelled_at !== null) {
            throw EventStateLocked::for($event);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Landing/form-config guard: view + update capability, allows DRAFT|PUBLISHED.
     *
     * LandingSetup, LandingPreview, and RegistrationFormConfig surfaces are
     * writable in both DRAFT and PUBLISHED states, unlike the stricter
     * authorizeEditFormAccess which only allows DRAFT.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizeLandingFormAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * Prepare-checklist guard: view + update capability.
     *
     * The prepare checklist is accessible in PUBLISHED state (it's the gate
     * to transition PUBLISHED→PREPARING). State validation is handled inside
     * EventStateMachineService during the actual prepare() call, not at the
     * component guard level.
     *
     * @throws AuthorizationException
     */
    public function authorizePrepareAccess(Event $event, User $actor): void
    {
        $this->authz->authorizeView($event, $actor);
        $this->metadata->authorizeEventUpdate($event->team, $actor);
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $metadata
     */
    public function createDraft(Team $team, User $actor, array $metadata): Event
    {
        return $this->metadata->createDraft($team, $actor, $metadata);
    }

    /**
     * Story 2-3b — Publish (DRAFT → PUBLISHED) with plan-gate triple-lock.
     *
     * Layer 3 of the triple-lock (FR80 / AR17): the service MUST re-check the
     * EVENT_PUBLISH entitlement even after the route capability + UI gate.
     * If the event team's plan does not grant PUBLISH, throws
     * PlanGateFailed (HTTP 402, JKM-EVT-1003).
     *
     * Idempotency comes for free from `transition()`'s same-state no-op.
     * Cancellation blocking comes from `transition()`'s cancelled_at re-read.
     */
    public function publish(Event $event, User $actor): Event
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publish($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @return array{allowed: bool, reason: string|null} */
    public function publishReadiness(Event $event, ?User $actor): array
    {
        return $this->lifecycle->publishReadiness($event, $actor);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertLandingSetup(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertLandingSetup($event, $actor, $payload);
    }

    /** @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload */
    public function upsertRegistrationFormConfig(Event $event, User $actor, array $payload): LandingPage
    {
        return $this->landing->upsertRegistrationFormConfig($event, $actor, $payload);
    }
    /** @param array<string, mixed> $payload */
    public function submitPublicRegistration(Event $event, array $payload, ?string $ipAddress): array
    {
        return $this->publicRegistration->submitPublicRegistration($event, $payload, $ipAddress);
    }

    /**
     * Story 4-17 — Resolve an Event by UUID for the delivery-logs surface.
     *
     * TeamScope bypass category: Authorization resolution — the route uses a plain
     * string parameter so TeamScope does not kill cross-team requests with 404 before
     * authorization runs. The event is found, then authorizeView enforces the team
     * boundary (403 for non-members, 200 for entitled members, bypass for SA).
     *
     * @throws \Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpException 404 if no event with this UUID, 403 if not authorized.

     * the capability registrar rejects argument-bound gate checks, so we
     * enforce the cross-team boundary explicitly before delegating to the
     * team-scoped capability.
     *

    private function assertCurrentTeamBoundary(User $actor, int $targetTeamId, string $message): void
    {
        $callerTeamId = $actor->currentTeam?->getKey();

            $actor,

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

        $systemAdminRole = Role::updateOrCreate(

            [
                'name' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->label(),
                'description' => 'Full system access across all teams and resources',
                'is_system_role' => true,
                'is_system_admin' => true,
            ]
        );

        // jakomeet team Administrator (Jetstream `admin` role).
        $adminRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::ADMIN->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::ADMIN->label(),
            'description' => 'Full access to all features within the workspace',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Billing Admin (Jetstream `billing-admin` role).
        $billingAdminRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->label(),
            'description' => 'Manages billing, invoices, and payment methods',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // jakomeet Co-host (Jetstream `co-host` role).
        $coHostRole = Role::updateOrCreate([
            'key' => UserRole::CO_HOST->value,
        ], [
            'name' => UserRole::CO_HOST->label(),
            'description' => 'Collaborates on events without access to billing or workspace settings',
            'is_system_role' => false,
            'is_system_admin' => false,
        ]);

        // Assign permissions to system admin (all global permissions)
        $systemAdminPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allGlobalPermissions();

        foreach ($systemAdminPermissions as $permission) {
            $systemAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to jakomeet team Administrator. The admin CSV is
        // primarily a platform/global matrix; tenant admins must always retain
        // the canonical team-scoped baseline even when that CSV is present.
        $adminPermissions = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(
            $this->defaultAdminPermissions(),
            $this->teamScopedPermissions($this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_admin.csv', 'Admin', ['+'])),
        )));

        foreach ($adminPermissions as $permission) {
            $adminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Billing Admin
        $billingPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Billing Admin', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($billingPermissions)) {
            $billingPermissions = $this->defaultBillingPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (billing admin is not a platform super-admin)
        $billingPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($billingPermissions);

        foreach ($billingPermissions as $permission) {
            $billingAdminRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        // Assign permissions to Co-host (collaborator, no billing / workspace-settings access)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->permissionsFromCsv('permissions_client.csv', 'Co-Host', ['true', '1', '+']);

        if (empty($coHostPermissions)) {
            $coHostPermissions = $this->defaultCoHostPermissions();
        }

        // Filter out global permissions (co-host is not a platform super-admin)
        $coHostPermissions = $this->teamScopedPermissions($coHostPermissions);

        foreach ($coHostPermissions as $permission) {
            $coHostRole->assignPermission($permission);
        }

        resolve(PermissionOrchestrator::class)->flushAll();
    }

    /**
     * Return the default Admin permissions when the CSV mapping is unavailable.
     */
    private function defaultAdminPermissions(): array
    {
        return array_filter(
            PermissionRegistry::teamPermissions(),
            function ($permission) {
                // Network settings and partner services are system-wide: regular admins can only VIEW
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'network_settings.') || str_starts_with($permission, 'partner_services.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Ticket categories: admins can only view
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'ticket_categories.')) {
                    return str_contains($permission, '.viewany.') || str_contains($permission, '.view.');
                }

                // Tickets: admins should not delete
                if (str_starts_with($permission, 'tickets.delete.')) {
                    return false;
                }

                return true;
            }
        );
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\AtddOracle;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Independent behavioural checks for the shared event page shell and the two
 * surfaces that adopt it (the new Event Overview page and the retrofitted
 * Landing Preview page).
 *
 * Every assertion is bound to a published seam: the named route, HTTP status,
 * the URLs of the existing event settings surfaces, and the existing shared
 * action model (EventActionAvailability). No assertion depends on class names,
 * file layout, CSS, or copy.
 */
class OracleTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fixtures
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team}
     */
    private function workspaceWithAdmin(): array
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $admin->id]);
        $admin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $admin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$admin->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function memberWithRole(Team $team, UserRole $role): User
    {
        $member = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $member->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => $role->value]);
        $member->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return $member->fresh();
    }

    private function eventFor(Team $team, User $creator, EventState $state, string $title): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($team)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $creator->id,
                'title' => $title,
            ])
            ->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the overview URL through the named route when it exists, and fall
     * back to the specified path so that a missing route name fails in exactly
     * one test rather than erroring in all of them.
     */
    private function overviewUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        if (Route::has('events.overview')) {
            return route('events.overview', $event->uuid);
        }

        return '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview';
    }

    private function previewUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        return '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/landing/preview';
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function formTags(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<form\b[^>]*>/i', $html, $matches);

        return $matches[0];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 — the new page exists on the named route and serves organizers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_is_reachable_through_the_named_route_for_an_authorized_organizer(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Quarterly Product Launch Briefing');

        $this->assertTrue(
            Route::has('events.overview'),
            'A named route "events.overview" must be registered for the event overview page.'
        );

        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('events.overview');
        $this->assertNotNull($route);
        $this->assertContains(
            'GET',
            $route->methods(),
            'events.overview must answer GET requests.'
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview',
            parse_url(route('events.overview', $event->uuid), PHP_URL_PATH),
            'events.overview must resolve to /events/{event:uuid}/overview.'
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee($event->title, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1/AC2 — the page renders through the shell, including the tab strip
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_renders_the_event_settings_tab_strip_for_this_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Settings Navigation Probe Event');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));
        $response->assertOk();

        foreach ([
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/landing/preview',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/form-config',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/custom-domain',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/automations',
        ] as $siblingSurface) {
            $response->assertSee($siblingSurface, false);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC4 — action visibility on the new page follows the shared action model
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_action_visibility_follows_the_shared_event_action_model(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $draft = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Draft Availability Probe');
        $published = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED, 'Published Availability Probe');

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class);
        $draftActions = $availability->for($admin, $draft);
        $publishedActions = $availability->for($admin, $published);

        // Fixture precondition, read from the shared model rather than hardcoded.
        $this->assertTrue(
            $draftActions['edit']['visible'] && $draftActions['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: the metadata edit action is available on a DRAFT event for an admin.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            $publishedActions['edit']['visible'] && $publishedActions['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: the metadata edit action is unavailable on a PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($draft))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($published))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — the new page is read-only
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_exposes_no_state_changing_control_for_the_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Read Only Surface Probe');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));
        $response->assertOk();

        $html = (string) $response->getContent();

        foreach ($this->formTags($html) as $formTag) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                $event->uuid,
                $formTag,
                'A read-only overview page must not submit any form for this event: '.$formTag
            );

            if (preg_match('/method\s*=\s*["\']?(post|put|patch|delete)/i', $formTag) === 1) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                    '/events/',
                    $formTag,
                    'A read-only overview page must not expose a mutating form for the events module: '.$formTag
                );
            }
        }

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            'wire:submit',
            $html,
            'A read-only overview page must not expose a component form submission.'
        );

        foreach (['publish', 'cancel', 'suspend', 'reactivate', 'force-end'] as $stateChangingVerb) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/'.$stateChangingVerb,
                $html,
                'A read-only overview page must not expose the '.$stateChangingVerb.' control.'
            );
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — view authorization is enforced, not just reflected in the UI
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_refuses_a_workspace_member_without_event_view_authorization(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Capability Boundary Probe Event');

        // Billing admins hold no events.* capability, so they may not view events.
        $billingAdmin = $this->memberWithRole($team, UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN);

        $response = $this->actingAs($billingAdmin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor without event view authorization must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_refuses_an_actor_from_another_workspace(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Cross Workspace Isolation Probe');

        [$outsider] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();

        $response = $this->actingAs($outsider)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor outside the event workspace must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_requires_an_authenticated_session(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Guest Access Probe Event');

        $response = $this->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertNotSame(
            200,
            $response->status(),
            'The overview page must not be served to unauthenticated visitors.'
        );
        $response->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — the retrofitted Landing Preview keeps its behaviour
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_keeps_action_driven_header_and_preview_body_after_shell_adoption(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $draft = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Preview Retrofit Draft Probe');
        $published = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED, 'Preview Retrofit Published Probe');

        foreach ([$draft, $published] as $event) {
            LandingPage::factory()
                ->for($event)
                ->state([
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => 'classic',
                ])
                ->create();
        }

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class);
        $this->assertTrue(
            $availability->for($admin, $draft)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is available on the DRAFT event.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            $availability->for($admin, $published)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is unavailable on the PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $draftResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($draft));
        $draftResponse->assertOk();
        // Preview body must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $draftResponse->assertSee($draft->title, false);
        // Action-model driven header must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $publishedResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($published));
        $publishedResponse->assertOk();
        $publishedResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $publishedResponse->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\AtddOracle;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Independent behavioural checks for the shared event page shell and the two
 * surfaces that adopt it (the new Event Overview page and the retrofitted
 * Landing Preview page).
 *
 * Every assertion is bound to a published seam: the named route, HTTP status,
 * the URLs of the existing event settings surfaces, and the existing shared
 * action model (EventActionAvailability). No assertion depends on class names,
 * file layout, CSS, or copy.
 */
class OracleTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Fixtures
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team}
     */
    private function workspaceWithAdmin(): array
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $admin->id]);
        $admin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $admin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$admin->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function memberWithRole(Team $team, UserRole $role): User
    {
        $member = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $member->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => $role->value]);
        $member->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return $member->fresh();
    }

    private function eventFor(Team $team, User $creator, EventState $state, string $title): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($team)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $creator->id,
                'title' => $title,
            ])
            ->fresh();
    }

    /**
     * Resolve the overview URL through the named route when it exists, and fall
     * back to the specified path so that a missing route name fails in exactly
     * one test rather than erroring in all of them.
     */
    private function overviewUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        if (Route::has('events.overview')) {
            return route('events.overview', $event->uuid);
        }

        return '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview';
    }

    private function previewUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        return '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/landing/preview';
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function formTags(string $html): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/<form\b[^>]*>/i', $html, $matches);

        return $matches[0];
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC2 — the new page exists on the named route and serves organizers
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_is_reachable_through_the_named_route_for_an_authorized_organizer(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Quarterly Product Launch Briefing');

        $this->assertTrue(
            Route::has('events.overview'),
            'A named route "events.overview" must be registered for the event overview page.'
        );

        $route = Route::getRoutes()->getByName('events.overview');
        $this->assertNotNull($route);
        $this->assertContains(
            'GET',
            $route->methods(),
            'events.overview must answer GET requests.'
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview',
            parse_url(route('events.overview', $event->uuid), PHP_URL_PATH),
            'events.overview must resolve to /events/{event:uuid}/overview.'
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee($event->title, false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1/AC2 — the page renders through the shell, including the tab strip
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_renders_the_event_settings_tab_strip_for_this_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Settings Navigation Probe Event');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));
        $response->assertOk();

        foreach ([
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/landing/preview',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/form-config',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/custom-domain',
            '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/automations',
        ] as $siblingSurface) {
            $response->assertSee($siblingSurface, false);
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC4 — action visibility on the new page follows the shared action model
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_action_visibility_follows_the_shared_event_action_model(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $draft = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Draft Availability Probe');
        $published = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED, 'Published Availability Probe');

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class);
        $draftActions = $availability->for($admin, $draft);
        $publishedActions = $availability->for($admin, $published);

        // Fixture precondition, read from the shared model rather than hardcoded.
        $this->assertTrue(
            $draftActions['edit']['visible'] && $draftActions['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: the metadata edit action is available on a DRAFT event for an admin.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            $publishedActions['edit']['visible'] && $publishedActions['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: the metadata edit action is unavailable on a PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($draft))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($published))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — the new page is read-only
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_exposes_no_state_changing_control_for_the_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Read Only Surface Probe');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));
        $response->assertOk();

        $html = (string) $response->getContent();

        foreach ($this->formTags($html) as $formTag) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                $event->uuid,
                $formTag,
                'A read-only overview page must not submit any form for this event: '.$formTag
            );

            if (preg_match('/method\s*=\s*["\']?(post|put|patch|delete)/i', $formTag) === 1) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                    '/events/',
                    $formTag,
                    'A read-only overview page must not expose a mutating form for the events module: '.$formTag
                );
            }
        }

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            'wire:submit',
            $html,
            'A read-only overview page must not expose a component form submission.'
        );

        foreach (['publish', 'cancel', 'suspend', 'reactivate', 'force-end'] as $stateChangingVerb) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/'.$stateChangingVerb,
                $html,
                'A read-only overview page must not expose the '.$stateChangingVerb.' control.'
            );
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — view authorization is enforced, not just reflected in the UI
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_refuses_a_workspace_member_without_event_view_authorization(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Capability Boundary Probe Event');

        // Billing admins hold no events.* capability, so they may not view events.
        $billingAdmin = $this->memberWithRole($team, UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN);

        $response = $this->actingAs($billingAdmin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor without event view authorization must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_refuses_an_actor_from_another_workspace(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Cross Workspace Isolation Probe');

        [$outsider] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();

        $response = $this->actingAs($outsider)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor outside the event workspace must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_requires_an_authenticated_session(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Guest Access Probe Event');

        $response = $this->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertNotSame(
            200,
            $response->status(),
            'The overview page must not be served to unauthenticated visitors.'
        );
        $response->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — the retrofitted Landing Preview keeps its behaviour
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_keeps_action_driven_header_and_preview_body_after_shell_adoption(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $draft = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Preview Retrofit Draft Probe');
        $published = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED, 'Preview Retrofit Published Probe');

        foreach ([$draft, $published] as $event) {
            LandingPage::factory()
                ->for($event)
                ->state([
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => 'classic',
                ])
                ->create();
        }

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class);
        $this->assertTrue(
            $availability->for($admin, $draft)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is available on the DRAFT event.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            $availability->for($admin, $published)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is unavailable on the PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $draftResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($draft));
        $draftResponse->assertOk();
        // Preview body must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $draftResponse->assertSee($draft->title, false);
        // Action-model driven header must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $publishedResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($published));
        $publishedResponse->assertOk();
        $publishedResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $publishedResponse->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }
}

            'Fixture precondition: the metadata edit action is unavailable on a PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($draft))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($published))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — the new page is read-only
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_exposes_no_state_changing_control_for_the_event(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Read Only Surface Probe');

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));
        $response->assertOk();

        $html = (string) $response->getContent();

        foreach ($this->formTags($html) as $formTag) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                $event->uuid,
                $formTag,
                'A read-only overview page must not submit any form for this event: '.$formTag
            );

            if (preg_match('/method\s*=\s*["\']?(post|put|patch|delete)/i', $formTag) === 1) {
                $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                    '/events/',
                    $formTag,
                    'A read-only overview page must not expose a mutating form for the events module: '.$formTag
                );
            }
        }

        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            'wire:submit',
            $html,
            'A read-only overview page must not expose a component form submission.'
        );

        foreach (['publish', 'cancel', 'suspend', 'reactivate', 'force-end'] as $stateChangingVerb) {
            $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
                '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/'.$stateChangingVerb,
                $html,
                'A read-only overview page must not expose the '.$stateChangingVerb.' control.'
            );
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — view authorization is enforced, not just reflected in the UI
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function event_overview_refuses_a_workspace_member_without_event_view_authorization(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Capability Boundary Probe Event');

        // Positive control: the page really is served to an entitled organizer,
        // so the refusal below cannot pass merely because the page is missing.
        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk();

        // Billing admins hold no events.* capability, so they may not view events.
        $billingAdmin = $this->memberWithRole($team, UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN);

        $response = $this->actingAs($billingAdmin)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor without event view authorization must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    public function event_overview_refuses_an_actor_from_another_workspace(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Cross Workspace Isolation Probe');

        // Positive control: the page really is served inside the owning workspace.
        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk();

        [$outsider] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();

        $response = $this->actingAs($outsider)->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertContains(
            $response->status(),
            [403, 404],
            'An actor outside the event workspace must be refused the overview page, got HTTP '.$response->status().'.'
        );
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString(
            $event->title,
            (string) $response->getContent(),
            'A refused actor must not receive the event content.'
        );
    }

    public function event_overview_requires_an_authenticated_session(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $event = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Guest Access Probe Event');

        $response = $this->get($this->overviewUrl($event));

        $this->assertNotSame(
            200,
            $response->status(),
            'The overview page must not be served to unauthenticated visitors.'
        );
        $response->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — the retrofitted Landing Preview keeps its behaviour
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_keeps_action_driven_header_and_preview_body_after_shell_adoption(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->workspaceWithAdmin();
        $draft = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT, 'Preview Retrofit Draft Probe');
        $published = $this->eventFor($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED, 'Preview Retrofit Published Probe');

        foreach ([$draft, $published] as $event) {
            LandingPage::factory()
                ->for($event)
                ->state([
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => 'classic',
                ])
                ->create();
        }

        $availability = app(EventActionAvailability::class);
        $this->assertTrue(
            $availability->for($admin, $draft)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is available on the DRAFT event.'
        );
        $this->assertFalse(
            $availability->for($admin, $published)['edit']['enabled'],
            'Fixture precondition: metadata edit is unavailable on the PUBLISHED event.'
        );

        $draftResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($draft));
        $draftResponse->assertOk();
        // Preview body must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $draftResponse->assertSee($draft->title, false);
        // Action-model driven header must survive the retrofit.
        $draftResponse->assertSee('/events/'.$draft->uuid.'/edit', false);

        $publishedResponse = $this->actingAs($admin)->get($this->previewUrl($published));
        $publishedResponse->assertOk();
        $publishedResponse->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $publishedResponse->assertDontSee('/events/'.$published->uuid.'/edit', false);
    }

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Read-only event overview surface.
 *
 * Renders through the shared event page shell. Access uses the same view
 * guard as the other event settings surfaces (EventService::authorizeViewAccess),
 * so the capability check does not live in the view layer.
 */
class EventOverview extends Component
{
    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId);

        return view('events::livewire.event-overview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Events module bootstrap.
 *
 * Rule 34: views live under app/Modules/Events/Resources/views and are
 * registered with the 'events' namespace. All view() calls from inside
 * this module MUST use the events:: prefix.
 */
class EventsServiceProvider extends ServiceProvider
{
    public function register(): void
    {
        $this->app->bind(EventRepositoryInterface::class, EventRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(SpeakerRepositoryInterface::class, SpeakerRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(RegistrationRepositoryInterface::class, RegistrationRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(ContactRepositoryInterface::class, ContactRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(AutomationDeliveryRepositoryInterface::class, AutomationDeliveryRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(AutomationExecutionRepositoryInterface::class, AutomationExecutionRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(AutomationConfigurationRepositoryInterface::class, AutomationConfigurationRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(AutomationSendingPauseRepositoryInterface::class, AutomationSendingPauseRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(AutomationUnsubscribeRepositoryInterface::class, AutomationUnsubscribeRepository::class);
        $this->app->bind(CustomDomainDnsVerifierInterface::class, FailClosedCustomDomainDnsVerifier::class);
        $this->app->bind(CustomDomainSslProvisionerInterface::class, FailClosedCustomDomainSslProvisioner::class);

        $this->app->singleton(EmailProvider::class, function ($app): EmailProvider {
            $configuredDriver = config('services.email.provider');
            $driver = $app->runningUnitTests()
                ? 'mock'
                : (is_string($configuredDriver) && $configuredDriver !== ''
                    ? strtolower($configuredDriver)
                    : ($app->environment('local') ? 'mock' : 'unsupported'));

            return match ($driver) {
                'mock' => $app->make(MockEmailProvider::class),
                'mailchimp_transactional' => $app->make(MailchimpTransactionalEmailProvider::class),
                default => throw new InvalidArgumentException("Unsupported email provider [{$driver}]."),
            };
        });
    }

    public function boot(): void
    {
        $this->loadViewsFrom(__DIR__.'/Resources/views', 'events');

        Gate::policy(Event::class, EventPolicy::class);
        EventCustomDomain::observe(EventCustomDomainObserver::class);

        $this->commands([
            Console\SendAutomationReminders::class,
        ]);

        $this->registerAutomationListeners();
        $this->registerLivewireComponents();
    }

    private function registerAutomationListeners(): void
    {
        $listener = AutomationLifecycleListener::class;

        EventDispatcher::listen(
            EventStateTransitioned::class,
            [$listener, 'handleStateTransitioned'],
        );
        EventDispatcher::listen(
            EventWentLive::class,
            [$listener, 'handleEventWentLive'],
        );
        EventDispatcher::listen(
            EventEnded::class,
            [$listener, 'handleEventEnded'],
        );
    }

    private function registerLivewireComponents(): void
    {
        Livewire::component('event-list', EventList::class);

        // Route-backed module components must be explicitly registered.
        // Otherwise the initial GET can render while the later Livewire
        // update POST fails with ComponentNotFoundException for the generated
        // app.modules.events.livewire.* snapshot name.
        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.landing-setup', LandingSetup::class);

        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.event-overview', EventOverview::class);
        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.prepare-checklist', PrepareChecklist::class);
        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.contact-form-modal', ContactFormModal::class);
        Livewire::component('events-contact-form-modal', ContactFormModal::class);
        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.contacts-manager', ContactsManager::class);
        Livewire::component('events-contacts-manager', ContactsManager::class);
        Livewire::component('app.modules.events.livewire.contact-csv-import-wizard', ContactCsvImportWizard::class);

        Livewire::component('events.viewer-lifecycle-monitor', ViewerLifecycleMonitor::class);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Shared event page shell — adopted by the new Event Overview page and by the
 * retrofitted Landing Preview page.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class EventPageShellAdoptionTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team, 2: Event}
     */
    private function organizerWithEvent(EventState $state = EventState::DRAFT): array
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $admin->id]);
        $admin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $admin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($team)
            ->create(['created_by' => $admin->id]);

        return [$admin->fresh(), $team->fresh(), $event->fresh()];
    }

    #[Test]
    public function overview_page_renders_through_the_shared_shell(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->organizerWithEvent();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.overview', $event->uuid));

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertSee($event->title, false);
        $response->assertSee('event-settings-tabs', false);
        $response->assertSee('event-page-shell-title', false);
        $response->assertSee('event-page-shell-actions', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_page_renders_through_the_same_shared_shell(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->organizerWithEvent();

        LandingPage::factory()
            ->for($event)
            ->state(['team_id' => $event->team_id, 'template' => 'classic'])
            ->create();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get('/events/'.$event->uuid.'/landing/preview');

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertSee('landing-preview-page', false);
        $response->assertSee('event-settings-tabs', false);
        $response->assertSee('event-page-shell-title', false);
        $response->assertSee('event-page-shell-actions', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function overview_page_is_read_only(): void
    {
        [$admin, , $event] = $this->organizerWithEvent();

        $response = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('events.overview', $event->uuid));

        $response->assertOk();
        $response->assertDontSee('/events/'.$event->uuid.'/publish', false);
        $response->assertDontSee('/events/'.$event->uuid.'/cancel', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function overview_page_refuses_an_actor_from_another_workspace(): void
    {
        [, , $event] = $this->organizerWithEvent();
        [$outsider] = $this->organizerWithEvent();

        $status = $this->actingAs($outsider)
            ->get('/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview')
            ->status();

        $this->assertContains($status, [403, 404]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

/**
 * Read-only event overview surface.
 *
 * Renders through the shared event page shell. Access uses the same view
 * guard as the other event settings surfaces (EventService::authorizeViewAccess),
 * so the capability check does not live in the view layer.
 */
class EventOverview extends Component
{
    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId);

        return view('events::livewire.event-overview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

**ORACLE=READY**

**8 test methods — 3 × S1, 5 × S2**

| Method | Sev | Guards |
|---|---|---|
| `event_overview_refuses_a_workspace_member_without_event_view_authorization` | S1 | Same-workspace actor with no event view capability must be refused (positive control first) |
| `event_overview_refuses_an_actor_from_another_workspace` | S1 | Cross-tenant actor refused, no content leak |
| `event_overview_requires_an_authenticated_session` | S1 | Guest redirected to login, never served |
| `event_overview_is_reachable_through_the_named_route_for_an_authorized_organizer` | S2 | Named route `events.overview`, GET, correct path, serves organizer |
| `event_overview_renders_the_event_settings_tab_strip_for_this_event` | S2 | Shell carries the settings navigation for this event |
| `event_overview_action_visibility_follows_the_shared_event_action_model` | S2 | Rendered actions compared against `EventActionAvailability` (DRAFT vs PUBLISHED) |
| `event_overview_exposes_no_state_changing_control_for_the_event` | S2 | No event form submission, no `wire:submit`, no publish/cancel/suspend/reactivate/force-end control |
| `landing_preview_keeps_action_driven_header_and_preview_body_after_shell_adoption` | S2 | Retrofit preserves preview body + test ids + action-gated header, and both pages show the same shell navigation |

Assertions bind only to named routes, HTTP status, event-scoped URLs, and the existing `EventActionAvailability` service — no class names, file paths, CSS, or copy.

**Validation:** base → 8 failed; reference → 8 passed (48 assertions); sabotage → 7 passed, 1 failed on `..._without_event_view_authorization` with `got HTTP 200`. Both patches `git apply --check` clean on base. Worktree reset to base; nothing committed.

**Reference variant:** extracts an anonymous `x-events::page-shell` (title + existing settings tab strip + actions slot, all driven by the passed action-availability array), adds a read-only `EventOverview` Livewire page on `events.overview` guarded by `EventService::authorizeViewAccess` plus an `events.view.team|events.view.global` route-permission entry, and moves the Landing Preview header onto the same shell while keeping its body, audit banner and test ids.

**Sabotage variant:** byte-identical except for the authorization shortcut — the route-permission entry becomes `null` ("read-only page, the scope handles isolation") and `mount()` drops the `authorizeViewAccess` call, so access is enforced only by the tab strip/action model hiding buttons; a billing admin in the same workspace gets a full 200 render of an event they may not view.

One environmental note: the harness's per-task `ATDD_TEST_DB` is overridden by `phpunit.xml`'s `<server name="DB_DATABASE" value="jakomeet_testing"/>`, so all five parallel oracle sessions share one test database and collide during `migrate:fresh`. I worked around it with retries rather than touching `phpunit.xml` or `.atdd-verify`; every result above is from a collision-free run.
